issues.quote: Four years on one watch, and he meant it to strike the first minute of the new century.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no duration for the repeater's making, and says nothing about how long the watch took to build.
issues.misreading: A solver could read 'four years' as a time frame relevant to the night, or as a clue about how long the repeater had been in progress, which the sheet does not support.

issues.quote: I had brandy, I will admit that, more than I should have.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says only that Félix went to the library after dinner and stayed there alone. It says nothing about his drinking.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this as a hint that Félix's perception of the times by his watch is unreliable, which the fact sheet does not state.
